task: Make completed story experience available as deduplicated playbook candidate material without activating it or treating DONE success as helped evidence.
outcome: After running playbook_seed_observe on a project with a DONE story, the user can see a done_experience seed; after digest-guarded propose and candidate approval, playbook_promotion_status shows candidatePlaybooks greater than zero while active playbooks and helped outcomes remain unchanged.
facts: PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED is default-on and records settlement health rows.
Current playbook_seed_observe only exposes dev_memory, finding_signal, and finding seed kinds.
Batch propose and candidate approval already have observeDigest and manifestDigest guards.
Candidate playbooks are intentionally inert until exposure and structured outcome evidence exist.
DONE experience text can be derived from summary.changes, summary.usage, summary.pitfalls, and delivery-check closingSelfCheck/docsPromises/realMachineTests.
Add a done-experience source filter while preserving all as the default aggregate view.
constraints: Do not implement automatic activation in Story 1.
Do not count DONE success alone as helped.
Do not run historical backfill in this story.
Keep the workflow host-neutral and non-authoritative; no gate evidence is produced.
